text: In 1885, Jonathan Harker arrives at Count Dracula's castle near Klausenburg posing as a librarian, secretly sworn to destroy the centuries-old vampire, and wakes with [bite marks on his neck|threat|blood drinkers]. Doctor Van Helsing follows his trail to Karlstadt, where the ailing Lucy Holmwood begs the maid to remove [his garlic bouquets|rules|faith and charms protect]. Soon [Lucy's tomb stands empty|images|graves, coffins and funerals], and Mina, who has quietly given the Count [permission to enter|rules|it must be let in], can no longer hold a crucifix.
